message: before=2020-01-01 in .npmrc takes the place of min-release-age (npm 11.19.1 uses before when both are set in the same file), so npm never installs a version published after 2020-01-01: that freezes dependencies, security fixes included, instead of a delay that moves with time
fix: Remove the before line from .npmrc, so that min-release-age applies; for a one-off install from a fixed date, pass --before on the command line
